verdict.rationale: SendGrid exposes a full REST API, SMTP relay, and official SDKs authenticated via an environment-variable API key, plus a sandbox mode to validate sends without delivering—collectively enabling scripted, headless use in CI/automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), an official CLI/IaC provider, and independent hands-on confirmation of running SendGrid calls inside a CI pipeline.
